notes: Model pilot (haiku arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole reads the held pole bonsai1/L10/N9052+ (zeroing the anchor removes 1.00 of this pole's activation), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Haiku 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: the back sleep sense fired strongly (0.94) and Reconstruction fired at 0.47 and 0.87, but Jews and Poland (0.36) were marginal and the card is mixed. A single label does not describe both senses, so the test is weak evidence for one pole meaning; the side-sleep and Civil War near misses are the hard edges.
